mechanism: For a contemplated course, state an unwanted outcome and reason as though it has already occurred. Ask what caused it and record course- and context-linked causal scenarios. Return those scenarios; selection, ranking, and response remain caller choices.
gloss: Simulating failure to identify hidden risks
failure_modes: Performative Doomerism: Recording generic disasters disconnected from the course or context.
invariants: Prospective Hindsight: During scenario generation, the selected unwanted outcome is treated as already having occurred, without asserting its probability.
Causal Specificity: Each recorded scenario names a causal explanation linked to the course and context; generic bad luck alone is insufficient.
postconditions: Course-linked causal failure scenarios, or an explicit none-found result, recorded.
